name: connected_rooks
description: The side to move has two rooks connected (on same rank or file with no pieces between them) while the opponent does not.
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'connected_rooks'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has two rooks connected (on same rank or file with no pieces between them) while the opponent does not.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm

    stm_rooks = board.pieces(chess.ROOK, stm)
    if len(stm_rooks) < 2:
        return False

    # Determine if stm has two connected rooks (same rank, clear path between them)
    stm_has_connected = False
    rook_list = list(stm_rooks)
    for i in range(len(rook_list)):
        r1 = rook_list[i]
        f1 = chess.square_file(r1)
        rk1 = chess.square_rank(r1)
        for j in range(i + 1, len(rook_list)):
            r2 = rook_list[j]
            f2 = chess.square_file(r2)
            rk2 = chess.square_rank(r2)
            if f1 == f2:
                # Same file: check if no pieces between them
                lo = min(rk1, rk2)
                hi = max(rk1, rk2)
                clear = True
                for rk in range(lo + 1, hi):
                    sq = chess.square(f1, rk)
                    if board.piece_at(sq) is not None:
                        clear = False
                        break
                if clear:
                    stm_has_connected = True
                    break
            elif rk1 == rk2:
                # Same rank: check if no pieces between them
                lo = min(f1, f2)
                hi = max(f1, f2)
                clear = True
                for f in range(lo + 1, hi):
                    sq = chess.square(f, rk1)
                    if board.piece_at(sq) is not None:
                        clear = False
                        break
                if clear:
                    stm_has_connected = True
                    break
        if stm_has_connected:
            break

    if not stm_has_connected:
        return False

    # Check opponent does not have connected rooks
    opp_rooks = board.pieces(chess.ROOK, opp)
    if len(opp_rooks) < 2:
        return True

    opp_rook_list = list(opp_rooks)
    for i in range(len(opp_rook_list)):
        r1 = opp_rook_list[i]
        f1 = chess.square_file(r1)
        rk1 = chess.square_rank(r1)
        for j in range(i + 1, len(opp_rook_list)):
            r2 = opp_rook_list[j]
            f2 = chess.square_file(r2)
            rk2 = chess.square_rank(r2)
            if f1 == f2:
                lo = min(rk1, rk2)
                hi = max(rk1, rk2)
                clear = True
                for rk in range(lo + 1, hi):
                    sq = chess.square(f1, rk)
                    if board.piece_at(sq) is not None:
                        clear = False
                        break
                if clear:
                    return False
            elif rk1 == rk2:
                lo = min(f1, f2)
                hi = max(f1, f2)
                clear = True
                for f in range(lo + 1, hi):
                    sq = chess.square(f, rk1)
                    if board.piece_at(sq) is not None:
                        clear = False
                        break
                if clear:
                    return False
    return True
